name: Acherontic-Orrery
description: Everything on this world is mid-formation: cones rising, calderas collapsing, new land cooling to black glass. The terrain gathers itself around an exposed planetary core, and by night the whole horizon pulses like a banked furnace.
The air carries ammonia and old snow, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
the pirate hideout changes hands often and quietly. Its current occupants trade fuel for silence and ask no questions about cargo.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
